correctness.evidence: Independent generator-only replay matched all stored invariants for all 1,386 rows; an independently written numerical-semigroup tree enumeration through genus 12 reproduced counts 1,1,2,4,7,12,23,39,67,118,204,343,592 and exactly the same generator sets for genera 6-12; all 63 (g,m) stratum sizes, maximum types, minimum Wilf numbers and stored witnesses also matched.

originality.evidence: The Boolean W>=0 claim is already subsumed by Delgado-Eliahou-Fromentin's verification through genus 100; A007323 gives genus counts and A199711 gives genus-by-multiplicity counts, so those are not novel. Compared substantive prior sources do not provide the exact integrated genus-6-12 per-semigroup corpus together with minimum-Wilf values and explicit witnesses for every (g,m) stratum. The originality finding is limited to that data/certificate layer.

scientific_value.evidence: The complete generator-indexed corpus and exact minimum-Wilf witnesses form a reproducible small-genus benchmark for semigroup enumeration and invariant implementations. Its value is modest and computational: it supplies exact boundary/reference data but proves no new general Wilf theorem and does not extend the known verification range.

decision: Validated: all three axes pass, with originality and scientific value confined to the integrated data/certificate and stratified minimum-Wilf witness layer.
